title: Content revision: cover submodule content so repositories with gitlinks get a source basis
outcome: Follow-up from the tm-5gi4 phase 1 review pair (Codex High, 2026-09-27). content_revision now fails closed on any 160000 index entry, because a presence-only entry gave a false 'unchanged' when a submodule's checkout, content or init state changed. PhoenixCodeNav (external/fsharp, external/roslyn) therefore has no basis, as it had none under schema-1. Wanted: a bounded way to include each submodule's content, e.g. its checked-out commit plus a dirty-state check through the pinned runner run inside the submodule, with deinit as a distinct state. Tests are needed for a changed checkout, an edit inside, and deinit. Also decide how filter config inside a submodule is treated.
disposal_reason: Duplicate found in backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 3b; Termal::Fable2). Content revision refusing gitlinks is covered by w-c07c410dac75, filed 2026-10-05 for the team pilot, which covers both submodules and Git filters or LFS and carries the Phoenix and pilot context. This item's notes stay linked as history.
